Screens:
  Capex Costs Screen:
    Properties:
      Fill: =gblAppStyles.Screen.Fill
      LoadingSpinner: =LoadingSpinner.Data
      OnVisible: |
        =UpdateContext(
            {
                locIsVisibleLoadingCostSpinner: true,
                locCapexInitialLoadPending: true,
                locCapexInitialLoadDone: false,
                locIsVisibleSubaccountCostsDeletionDialog: false,
                locSpinnerInformationText: "",
                locIsVisibleProjectCostsMargin: false,
                locIsVisiblePopUpSpinner: false,
                locIsVisibleRightPanelSubaccountCostsEdit: false,
                locIsVisibleRightPanelSubaccountCostsDistributeEqually: false,
                locIsVisibleRightPanelEditMargin: false,
                locSelectedSubaccountCommandMode: gblAppConstants.Form.Display,
                locIsAddingStandardContract: false,
                locPanelReady: false,
                locBindGallery: false,
                locStartBinding: false,
                locIsVisibleCapexComments: false,
                locEditSaveButtonEnabled: false,
                locSelectedAccount: Blank(),
                locSelectedCostRow: Blank(),
                locScreenVisitStamp: GUID()
            }
        );
        // Set selected project
        If(
            Not(IsBlank(Param("projectId"))),
            Set(
                gblSelectedProject,
                LookUp(
                    Projects,
                    Project = GUID(Param("projectId"))
                )
            ),
            Set(
                gblSelectedProject,
                LookUp(
                    Projects,
                    Project = GUID("33b9cc79-5b4f-f111-bec6-000d3a3855c2")
                )
            )
        );
        // Project start cluster number
        UpdateContext(
            {
                locProjectStartClusterNo: Switch(
                    Coalesce(
                        gblSelectedProject.'Start Cluster',
                        'Cluster States'.Greenfield
                    ),
                    'Cluster States'.Greenfield,
                    0,
                    'Cluster States'.'Cluster 1',
                    1,
                    'Cluster States'.'Cluster 2',
                    2,
                    'Cluster States'.'Cluster 3',
                    3,
                    'Cluster States'.'Cluster 4',
                    4,
                    'Cluster States'.'Cluster 5',
                    5,
                    'Cluster States'.'Cluster 6',
                    6,
                    0
                )
            }
        );
        // Calculate allowed cost start year/date
        With(
            {
                varPreferredStartDate: If(
                    locProjectStartClusterNo > 0,
                    gblSelectedProject.'Acquisition date',
                    gblSelectedProject.'Project Start Date'
                ),
                varFallbackStartDate: Coalesce(
                    gblSelectedProject.'Acquisition date',
                    gblSelectedProject.'Project Start Date',
                    Today()
                )
            },
            With(
                {
                    varCostStartDate: If(
                        !IsBlank(varPreferredStartDate) && Year(varPreferredStartDate) > 1900,
                        varPreferredStartDate,
                        varFallbackStartDate
                    )
                },
                UpdateContext(
                    {
                        locCostAllowedStartYear: If(
                            Year(varCostStartDate) > 1900,
                            Year(varCostStartDate),
                            Year(Today())
                        ),
                        locCostAllowedStartDate: Date(
                            If(
                                Year(varCostStartDate) > 1900,
                                Year(varCostStartDate),
                                Year(Today())
                            ),
                            1,
                            1
                        )
                    }
                )
            )
        );
        // Calculate navigation min/max year
        With(
            {
                varAcquisitionYear: With(
                    {d: gblSelectedProject.'Acquisition date'},
                    If(
                        !IsBlank(d) && Year(d) > 1900,
                        Year(d),
                        Blank()
                    )
                ),
                varCODYear: With(
                    {d: gblSelectedProject.'Operations start date (COD)'},
                    If(
                        !IsBlank(d) && Year(d) > 1900,
                        Year(d),
                        Blank()
                    )
                ),
                varProjectEndYear: With(
                    {d: gblSelectedProject.'End Date'},
                    If(
                        !IsBlank(d) && Year(d) > 1900,
                        Year(d),
                        Blank()
                    )
                ),
                varMinClusterYear: Min(
                    Filter(
                        gblClusterDurations,
                        !IsBlank(StartYear) && StartYear > 1900
                    ),
                    StartYear
                ),
                varMaxClusterYear: Max(
                    Filter(
                        gblClusterDurations,
                        !IsBlank(EndYear) && EndYear > 1900
                    ),
                    EndYear
                )
            },
            UpdateContext(
                {
                    locNavigationMinYear: Coalesce(
                        Min(
                            Filter(
                                Table(
                                    {Y: varAcquisitionYear},
                                    {Y: varMinClusterYear},
                                    {Y: locCostAllowedStartYear}
                                ),
                                !IsBlank(Y) && Y > 1900
                            ),
                            Y
                        ),
                        Year(Today())
                    ),
                    locNavigationMaxYear: Coalesce(
                        Max(
                            Filter(
                                Table(
                                    {Y: varCODYear},
                                    {Y: varProjectEndYear},
                                    {Y: varMaxClusterYear},
                                    {
                                        Y: If(
                                            gblSelectedProjectYear > 1900,
                                            gblSelectedProjectYear
                                        )
                                    }
                                ),
                                !IsBlank(Y) && Y > 1900
                            ),
                            Y
                        ),
                        Year(Today())
                    )
                }
            )
        );
        // Build year dropdown collection
        ClearCollect(
            colProjectPeriods,
            ForAll(
                Sequence(
                    Max(
                        locNavigationMaxYear - locNavigationMinYear + 1,
                        1
                    ),
                    locNavigationMinYear,
                    1
                ) As ProjectYearNumber,
                {
                    Year: ProjectYearNumber.Value,
                    Month: ForAll(
                        Sequence(12) As MonthNumber,
                        {
                            Name: Text(
                                Date(
                                    2000,
                                    MonthNumber.Value,
                                    1
                                ),
                                "mmmm"
                            ),
                            Number: MonthNumber.Value
                        }
                    )
                }
            )
        );
        // Safe selected year
        With(
            {
                varDefaultYear: Coalesce(
                    gblSelectedProjectYear,
                    locCostAllowedStartYear,
                    locNavigationMinYear,
                    Year(Today())
                )
            },
            Set(
                gblSelectedProjectYear,
                Min(
                    Max(
                        varDefaultYear,
                        locNavigationMinYear
                    ),
                    locNavigationMaxYear
                )
            )
        );
        // Select real CAPEX category, not DEVEX/CAPEX Summary
        UpdateContext(
            {
                locSelectedCapexAccountCategory: Coalesce(
                    If(
                        !IsBlank(locSelectedCapexAccountCategory.'CAPEX Account List'),
                        locSelectedCapexAccountCategory
                    ),
                    First(
                        SortByColumns(
                            Filter(
                                colCapexAccountCategoriesNew,
                                !IsBlank('CAPEX Account List') && Not(Name = "Overleveraging")
                            ),
                            "vsb_order",
                            SortOrder.Ascending
                        )
                    )
                ),
                locSelectedAccount: Blank(),
                locSelectedCostRow: Blank()
            }
        );
        // Build PCF data only if base data is ready
        If(
            gblAppStarted && !IsBlank(gblSelectedProject) && !IsBlank(locSelectedCapexAccountCategory.'CAPEX Account List') && CountRows(colCapexAccountCategoriesNew) > 1 && CountRows(colCapexAccountsNew) > 0 && CountRows(colCapexSubaccountsNew) > 0,
            Reset(tab_Costs_ContentAssignableAccountCategories);
            Select(btn_Capex_Cost_Refresh_Capex_Cost_Code);
            Select(btn_Capex_Cost_Build_StandardContractOptions_Code);
            UpdateContext(
                {
                    locIsVisibleLoadingCostSpinner: false,
                    locCapexInitialLoadPending: false,
                    locCapexInitialLoadDone: true
                }
            ),
            UpdateContext(
                {
                    locIsVisibleLoadingCostSpinner: false,
                    locCapexInitialLoadPending: true,
                    locCapexInitialLoadDone: false
                }
            )
        );
    Children:

            PaddingBottom: =0

            RadiusBottomRight: =0
            RadiusTopLeft: =0
            RadiusTopRight: =0
            Size: =14
            Text: =Last(colCapexAccountCategoriesNew).Name
            VerticalAlign: =VerticalAlign.Top
            Visible: =false
            Width: =96
            X: =40

      - btn_Capex_Cost_Reload_PCF_After_Mutation_Code:
          Control: ModernButton@1.0.0
          Properties:
            OnSelect: |
              =UpdateContext({locIsVisibleLoadingCostSpinner: true});
              Refresh('CAPEX Project Contracts');
              Refresh('CAPEX Costs');
              ClearCollect(
                  colCapexProjectContracts,
                  Filter(
                      'CAPEX Project Contracts',
                      Account.'CAPEX Account List' in colCapexSubaccountsNew.'CAPEX Account List',
                      Project.Project = gblSelectedProject.Project
                  )
              );
              ClearCollect(
                  colCapexCosts,
                  Defaults('CAPEX Costs')
              );
              Collect(
                  colCapexCosts,
                  Ungroup(
                      ShowColumns(
                          AddColumns(
                              colCapexProjectContracts As Item,
                              Value,
                              ShowColumns(
                                  Filter(
                                      'CAPEX Costs',
                                      Contract.'CAPEX Project Contract' = Item.'CAPEX Project Contract'
                                  ),
                                  Year,
                                  Name,
                                  Month,
                                  Cost,
                                  Contract,
                                  'CAPEX Cost',
                                  'Cost Paid'
                              )
                          ),
                          Value
                      ),
                      Value
                  )
              );
              Select(btn_Capex_Cost_Refresh_Capex_Cost_Code);
              Select(btn_Capex_Cost_Build_StandardContractOptions_Code);
              UpdateContext(
                  {
                      locIsVisibleLoadingCostSpinner: false,
                      locIsVisiblePopUpSpinner: false
                  }
              );
            Visible: =false
            X: =260
            Y: =260
      - tmr_Capex_Initial_Load:
          Control: Timer@2.1.0
          Properties:
            Duration: =500
            OnTimerEnd: "=If(\n    locCapexInitialLoadPending &&\n    !locCapexInitialLoadDone &&\n    gblAppStarted &&\n    !IsBlank(gblSelectedProject) &&\n          locStartCategoryBinding1: false\n        }\n    );\n\n    UpdateContext(\n        {\n            locSelectedCapexAccountCategory: LookUp(\n                colCapexAccountCategoriesNew,\n                Name = \"DEVEX/CAPEX Summary\"\n            ),\n            locSelectedAccount: Blank(),\n            locSelectedCostRow: Blank()\n        }\n    );\n\n    Reset(tab_Costs_ContentAssignableAccountCategories);\n\n  If(\n    IsBlank(locSelectedCapexAccountCategory.'CAPEX Account List'),\n\n    Clear(colFinatCostDataOptimized);\n    Clear(colStandardContractOptionsForPCF);\n\n    ClearCollect(\n        colCapexSummaryCategories,\n        Filter(\n            colCapexAccountCategoriesNew,\n            Not(IsBlank('CAPEX Account    },\n                With(\n                    {\n                        lclContracts: Filter(\n                            colCapexProjectContracts,\n                            Account.'CAPEX       - btn_Capex_Cost_Add_New_EqualDistribution_Cost_Calculate_Cluster_Range_Out_Of_LinkedCost:
          Control: Button@0.0.45
          Properties:
            OnSelect: |
              =ClearCollect(
                  colOtherClusterHavingCost,
                  With(
                      {
                          otherClusters: gblClusterDurations
                          /*Filter(
                              gblClusterDurations,
                              Order <> drp_Add_Edit_Cost_Data_RightPanel_Form_Link_to_Cluster.Selected.Order
                          )*/
                      },
                      Filter(
                          otherClusters As CL,
                          CountIf(
                              colCapexCostDataToPatch As C,
                              With(
                                  {
                                      y: Value(C.Year),
                                      m: Value(C.Month),
                                      sy: Value(CL.StartYear),
                                      sm: Value(CL.StartMonth),
                                      ey: Value(CL.EndYear),
                                      em: Value(CL.EndMonth)
                                  },
                                  And(
                                      Or(
                                          y > sy,
                                          And(
                                              y = sy,
                                              m >= sm
                                          )
                                      ),
                                      Or(
                                          y < ey,
                                          And(
                                              y = ey,
                                              m <= em
                                          )
                                      )
                                  )
                              )
                          ) > 0
                      )
                  )
              );
            Visible: =false
            X: =200
            Y: =200

                                            )

                                                IsModified = true
                                            )
                                        ) > 0
                                    },

                                        // BLOCK: If any field is actively blanked out, lock the save button immediately

                                        // ENABLE: If there are live keystroke changes, or staged memory changes, enable it
                                        _hasLiveValidChanges Or _hasDeletions Or _hasModifiedRecords,
                                        DisplayMode.Edit,
                                        // DEFAULT: Lock it

                  With(

                      ClearCollect(

                                      ForAll(
                                          locClustersForFullDistribution As cluster,
                                          With(
                                              {

                                  SortOrder.Ascending,

                              )

                          With(
                              {
                                  avgPay: RoundDown(

                                      0
                                  ),
                                  lastPay: locTotalCostToDistribute - RoundDown(
                                      locTotalCostToDistribute / locTotalNumberOfAllPayments,

                                  ) * (locTotalNumberOfAllPayments - 1),
                                  LastMonth: Last(locSortedAllPayments).Month,

                                          Year: r.Year,
                                          Month: r.Month,

                                              avgPay
                                          )
                                      }
                                  )
                              );
                              ClearCollect(
                                  colCapexCostDataToPatch,
                                  Filter(
                                      colCapexCostDataAllPaymentsWithCost As CostRow,

                                              2,
                                              [@Month].February,
                                              3,
                                              [@Month].March,
                                              4,
                                              [@Month].April,
                                              5,
                                              [@Month].May,
                                              6,
                                              [@Month].June,
                                              7,
                                              [@Month].July,
                                              8,
                                              [@Month].August,
                                              9,
                                              [@Month].September,
                                              10,
                                              [@Month].October,
                                              11,
                                              [@Month].November,
                                              12,
                                              [@Month].December
                                          ),
                                          Cost: r.Cost,
                                          'Owning Business Unit': gblSelectedProject.'Besitzer (Unternehmenseinheit)',
                                          'Capex Contract Standard Assumption': locStandardContractAssumption
                                      }
                                  )
                              );
                              Patch(
                                  'CAPEX Project Contracts',
                                  locSelectedProjectContract,
                                  {
                                      'Average Payment': Value(avgPay),
                                      'Total Cost': Sum(
                                          colCapexCostDataToPatch,
                                          Cost
                                      )
                                  }
                              )

                              locStandardContractAssumption: Blank(),

                              locGUIDforLoadingStandardContract: Blank(),
                              locIsAddingStandardContract: false
                          }

                          Clear(colCapexCostDataAllPayments),
                          Clear(colCapexCostDataAllPaymentsWithCost),
                          Clear(colStandardCostAllSelectedClusters),
                          Clear(colEligibleStandardCostClusters),
                          Refresh('Devex/Capex Standard Assumptions')
                      )
                  )
